newsitem.title: USA: Breed says acquisitions to weigh on profit.
newsitem.headline: Breed says acquisitions to weigh on profit.

text.p: Breed Technologies Chief Executive Allen Breed on Monday said profits would be weighed down in coming quarters as the automobile supplier digested several recent acquistions.
"Some of these restructuring things will hurt our earnings per share for the next few quarters," Breed told investors at a conference sponsored by Raymond James & Associates Inc.

A specialist in automobile safety technology such as air-bag parts, Breed Technologies has bought nine companies since 1994, including the January acquisition of a custom-trim company and earlier an Italian electronics manufacturer.

Breed made no earnings forecasts. Wall Street analysts surveyed by First Call are estimating the company will earn $0.32 to $0.50 a share in the third fiscal quarter ending March 30. The mean estimate is $0.43 a share, down from the $0.47 earned in the comparable period the previous year.
